title: Video | West Bengal, Odisha On Rain Alert As IMD Forecasts Heavy To Very Heavy Rains - NDTV
article_text: West Bengal and Odisha remain on alert as heavy rainfall is expected across several parts over the next few days. The India Meteorological Department has forecast heavy rain, thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds across several districts of North and South Bengal over the next 48 hours. Authorities and residents are likely to remain watchful as weather conditions could intensify across affected areas. The forecast comes amid continued monsoon activity across eastern India, with heavy showers expected in multiple districts.
